notablePrerequisites: You have at least six land cards in your graveyard.
description:
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing Drownyard Temple.
Each Scouring Swarm you control triggers, creating a tapped token copy of itself.
Resolve the Troubled Healer ability.
If you control four or more Scouring Swarms, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Scouring Swarm, adding {R}.
Repeat step 4 until you control three Scouring Swarms or until you have {3} available, whichever comes first.
Activate Drownyard Temple by paying {3}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
